body: New packages/simulation/arena_replay.h/.c parses apps/arena match logs and drives ArenaState directly, interpolating between 500ms snapshots. New red_garden_arena --observe <path> flag plays a match back through the exact same render loop as live play. 6 new headless tests, all green (test_arena.sh + test_10_bots.sh both still pass). RTS-side playback and true live-tailing remain open next steps. Commit c9e05e6. BACKLOG S170-30.
